scripts.text:
SELECT /*+parallel(4)+*/
 MAX(BATCH_ID) AS BATCH_ID_INITIAL
 FROM AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL
WHERE FILE_TYPE = 'I'
AND FILE_PROCESSED_DT = TRUNC(SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO AGP.PRF_CALC_INPUT_MAPPING
(
        BATCH_ID,
        RECORD_TYPE,   
        RID,  
        BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT, 
        BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
        MCE_EFF_DT,    
        MCE_TERM_DT,   
        MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED ,  
        MONTHS_ARREARS, 
        INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING,
        LAST_PAC_AMT,
        STATE_PAC_FUNDED,
        MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,
        MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT_BASIC,
        MEM_DISC_PERCENTAGE,
        STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,
        MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,
        STATE_CONTRIBUTION,
        MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,
        TOTAL_ANNUAL_REQ_PAY,
        MEM_DISCOUNT_APPLIED,
        STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,
        STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE,
        MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        MEM_PENALTY,
        MEM_REFUND_AMT,
        STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,
        TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,
        MEM_DEBT,
        MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,  
        PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG,   
        MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,  
        STATE_DISC_PAY_APPLIED,
        MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND, 
        STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,
        MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
        MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,
        DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,
        STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
        MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,
        STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT
)
SELECT  /*+parallel(4)+*/
        @BATCH_ID_Initial, 
        LTRIM(RTRIM(RECORD_TYPE)),             
        LTRIM(RTRIM(RID)),
        TO_DATE(BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,      
        TO_DATE(BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,  
        TO_DATE(MCE_EFF_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS MCE_EFF_DT,      
        TO_DATE(MCE_TERM_DT,'yyyy/mm/dd') AS MCE_TERM_DT,
        CAST(MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED AS NUMBER) AS MONTHS_MEM_INCURRED,  
        CAST(MONTHS_ARREARS AS NUMBER) AS MONTHS_ARREARS, 
        CAST(INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING AS NUMBER) AS INCURRED_MONTH_REMAINING,
        CAST(LAST_PAC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS LAST_PAC_AMT,
        CAST(STATE_PAC_FUNDED AS NUMBER) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED,
        CAST(MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE AS NUMBER) AS MEM_PAY_PRIOR_MCE,
        CAST(MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        CAST(MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        CAST(MEM_DISC_PERCENTAGE AS NUMBER) AS MEM_DISC_PERCENTAGE,
        CAST(STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT,
        CAST(TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS TOTAL_ROLLOVER_DISC_AMT ,
        CAST(MEM_OVERPAYMENTS AS NUMBER) AS MEM_OVERPAYMENTS,
        CAST(MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY AS NUMBER) AS MEM_ACT_CASH_PAY,
        CAST(STATE_CONTRIBUTION AS NUMBER) AS STATE_CONTRIBUTION,
        CAST(MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED AS NUMBER) AS MEM_REQ_CONT_ENROLLED,
        CAST(TOTAL_ANNUAL_REQ_PAY AS NUMBER) AS TOTAL_ANNUAL_REQ_PAY,
        CAST(MEM_DISCOUNT_APPLIED AS NUMBER) AS MEM_DISCOUNT_APPLIED,
        CAST(STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT AS NUMBER) AS STATE_DISCOUNT_AMT,
        CAST(STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE AS NUMBER) AS STATE_PAC_FUNDED_BALANCE ,
        CAST(MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE AS NUMBER) AS MEM_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        CAST(STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE AS NUMBER) AS STATE_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        CAST(TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE AS NUMBER) AS TOTAL_CLAIMS_PAID_BY_MCE,
        CAST(MEM_PENALTY AS NUMBER) AS MEM_PENALTY,
        CAST(MEM_REFUND_AMT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_REFUND_AMT,
        CAST(STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT AS NUMBER) AS STATE_PAC_REFUND_AMT,
        CAST(TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT AS NUMBER) AS TOTAL_REFUND_WITH_PEN_AMT,
        CAST(MEM_DEBT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_DEBT,
        CAST(MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP AS NUMBER) AS MEM_UNFUNDED_DEBT_CMSCAP,                      
        LTRIM(RTRIM(PREVENTATIVE_SERVICES_FLAG)),   
        CAST(MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER AS NUMBER) AS MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER,  
        CAST(MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER AS NUMBER) AS MEM_STATE_RECOUP_ROLLOVER, 
        CAST(MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND AS NUMBER) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND , 
        CAST(STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND AS NUMBER) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_REFUND,
        CAST(MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE AS NUMBER) AS MEM_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
        CAST(MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_OVERPAY_BY_DISCOUNT,
        CAST(DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT AS NUMBER) AS DEBT_COLL_PRIOR_DEBT,
        CAST(STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE AS NUMBER) AS STATE_ROLLOVER_PAID_PRIOR_MCE,
        CAST(MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS MEM_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT,
        CAST(STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT AS NUMBER) AS STATE_PRIOR_YEAR_DISC_AMT   
FROM AGP.PRF_INBOUND_IN_FILE_STAGING

UPDATE AGP.INMCD_PRF_CONTROL PRFC
SET PRFC.RECORD_COUNT = (SELECT COUNT(1) 
                    FROM AGP.PRF_CALC_INPUT_MAPPING PRFI
                    WHERE PRFI.BATCH_ID = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name))
WHERE PRFC.BATCH_ID = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
AND PRFC.FILE_TYPE = 'I'
